Grubhub (GRUB) Shareholder Lourd Capital Has Trimmed Stake by $1.32 Million as Stock Price Rose; Cameco (CCJ) Holder Beutel Goodman & Co LTD Has Cut Its Position by $2.22 Million 
April 18, 2018 - By wolcottdaily 
Beutel Goodman & Co Ltd decreased its stake in Cameco Corp (CCJ) by 1.05% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Beutel Goodman & Co Ltd sold 246,285 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.93% with the market. The institutional investor held 23.20M shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $215.21 million, down from 23.45M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Beutel Goodman & Co Ltd who had been investing in Cameco Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.95 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.46% or $0.15 during the last trading session, reaching $10.4. About 2.35 million shares traded or 15.03% up from the average. Cameco Corporation (NYSE:CCJ) has declined 17.95% since April 18, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 29.50% the S&P500. 
Lourd Capital Llc decreased its stake in Grubhub Inc (GRUB) by 67.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lourd Capital Llc sold 18,533 shares as the company’s stock rose 44.05% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 8,924 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $641,000, down from 27,457 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lourd Capital Llc who had been investing in Grubhub Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $9.04 billion market cap company. The stock increased 5.30% or $5.22 during the last trading session, reaching $103.72. About 2.33M shares traded or 25.81% up from the average. GrubHub Inc. (NYSE:GRUB) has risen 206.92% since April 18, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 195.37% the S&P500.

The firm has “Underperform” rating given on Friday, June 30 by Bank of America. On Thursday, August 6 the stock rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Market Perform”. The firm has “Buy” rating by RBC Capital Markets given on Friday, October 20. The firm has “Sector Perform” rating by RBC Capital Markets given on Thursday, February 2.

After $0.36 actual EPS reported by Cameco Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -105.56% negative EPS growth.

It also increased its holding in Ingersoll (NYSE:IR) by 88,528 shares in the quarter, for a total of 2.14M shares, and has risen its stake in Eli Lilly & Co (NYSE:LLY). 
Among 33 analysts covering Grubhub Inc ( NYSE:GRUB ), 18 have Buy rating, 3 Sell and 12 Hold. Therefore 55% are positive. The rating was maintained by KeyBanc Capital Markets with “Overweight” on Thursday, February 22. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Friday, October 27 by DA Davidson. The stock of GrubHub Inc. (NYSE:GRUB) has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, August 10 by Canaccord Genuity. The rating was maintained by Canaccord Genuity with “Buy” on Friday, May 26. Credit Suisse maintained it with “Neutral” rating and $80 target in Friday, February 9 report.

After $0.31 actual EPS reported by GrubHub Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -12.90% negative EPS growth.
